issues.message: EV/Sales above 100x is an extreme valuation without a concrete denominator bug signal; treat it as valuation risk, not an automatic period-denominator bug.
SBC/Revenue above 100% indicates a likely period denominator mismatch.
Early-commercial capital-intensive tech profile requires manual review until FCF path, backlog conversion and execution milestones are evidenced.
Technical analysis dominates the fundamental rating rationale.
